name: Push original spent maces and follow corridor center around wall fixtures

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local t=-3
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during original spent-mace passage')
 local goal=util.vector3(-4928,-1870,-1057)
 local v=goal-self.position;local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0));local yaw=math.atan2(f.y*v.x-f.x*v.y,f.x*v.x+f.y*v.y)
 print(string.format('VilverinContinue mace aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(yaw*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(-camera.getPitch()*256+.5)))))
 if math.abs(yaw)<.06 then print('VilverinContinue mace facing') end
 print('VilverinContinue mace sample pos='..tostring(self.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
 if self.position.y>-1900 and self.position.z>-1090 then print('VilverinContinue mace passage clear') end
 for _,id in ipairs({{0xc4986,0x6c605}}) do
  local a=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',id));assert(a and a:isValid(),'Original mace missing')
  print('VilverinContinue mace body reference='..id..' bounds='..tostring(a:getBoundingBox().center))
 end
end}}}}
